name: growth factor independent 1 transcriptional repressor
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: GFI1 encodes zinc finger protein Gfi-1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neutropenia, severe congenital, 2, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Medulloblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
